title: A History in UI Development — 60-Year Macro & Web UI Trends

eras.name: Batch & Light-Pen Vector CRT
eras.summary: Direct-view vector refresh CRTs, light-pen tracking crosses, and early time-sharing consoles pioneered spatial manipulation and hypertext before raster bitmaps.

eras.name: Block-Mode & Character Terminal (TUI)
eras.summary: Synchronous block-mode forms (IBM 3270) and full-duplex VT100 character terminals standardized tabular data entry, reverse-video field focus, and bottom function-key strips.

eras.name: Early Bitmap WIMP & Desktop Metaphor
eras.summary: High-contrast 1-bit dithered bitmaps introduced pull-down global menu bars, overlapping title-bar windows, scrollbars, spatial desktop icons, and direct manipulation.

eras.name: Color Workstations, 3D Bevels & Hypermedia
eras.webLayoutEngine: Pre-Web HyperCard / Motif / NeXT Display PostScript
eras.summary: Chiseled 3D Motif/NeXTSTEP bevels, floating tear-off inspectors, MDI document workspaces, and HyperCard hypermedia stacks bridged desktop software to the birth of the Web.

eras.name: Early Web 1.0 Documents, Framesets & Directories
eras.dominantInput: Pointer Click on Blue Underlined Anchor Links
eras.summary: The early World Wide Web rendered linear hypertext documents, gray bevel browser chrome, server-side image maps, multi-pane HTML framesets, and hierarchical link directories.

eras.name: Dot-Com Table Portals, Skinned Apps & Flash Vector
eras.dominantInput: Mouse Rollovers, Custom Cursors & Form Widgets
eras.webLayoutEngine: HTML Nested Table Grids & Spacer GIFs
eras.summary: Dense 3-column nested HTML table portals, 1px spacer GIF grids, DHTML rollover menus, custom-skinned desktop media players, and animated Flash vector microsites.

eras.name: Web 2.0 Ajax RIAs, Glossy Tabs & Social Streams
eras.dominantInput: Asynchronous DOM Click, Drag-Pan & Inline Edit
eras.summary: XMLHttpRequest unlocked desktop-grade Rich Internet Applications (Gmail, Google Maps) with CSS float layouts, glossy gradients, rounded tab strips, tag clouds, and RSS feeds.

eras.name: Mobile Multi-Touch, Skeuomorphism & 960px Grids
eras.summary: Capacitive touchscreens replaced styluses and scrollbars with inertial flicking, bottom tab bars, stitched-leather skeuomorphic chrome, and standardized 960px 12-column web grids.

eras.name: Flat Design, Material Cards & Responsive SaaS
eras.dominantInput: Touch + Trackpad Scroll, Off-Canvas Drawers & FAB
eras.summary: Swiss typography, Metro/iOS 7 flat minimalism, Google Material elevation cards, off-canvas hamburger menus, and SPA component trees (React/Angular) reshaped web apps.

eras.name: Design Systems, Multiplayer Canvases & Dark Mode
eras.dominantInput: Multiplayer Cursors, Command Palette & Trackpad Zoom
eras.webLayoutEngine: CSS Grid, Custom Properties & WebGL Canvas
eras.summary: Native CSS Grid, semantic dark-mode design tokens, block-based collaborative editors (Notion), and WebGL multiplayer infinite canvases (Figma) blurred document and application boundaries.

eras.name: Keyboard-First `⌘K`, Bento Grids & AI Copilots
eras.webLayoutEngine: CSS Subgrid, Container Queries & Bento Layouts
eras.summary: Sub-50ms local-first sync, ubiquitous `⌘K` command palettes, high-craft glassmorphic bento grids, and inline AI copilot chat/artifact sidebars redefined developer and creative workflows.

eras.name: Agentic Workflows, Malleable UI & Spatial Glass
eras.webLayoutEngine: Generative Ephemeral DOM, Spatial Ornaments & Canvas
eras.summary: Interfaces shift from static navigation hierarchies to intent-driven agentic workspaces, streaming artifact diffs, verification ledgers, and eye-tracked spatial glass ornaments.
